landing.heroSubtitle: Set up a support portal for your organization in minutes. Your customers submit and track requests without creating an account — your team manages everything from one dashboard.
landing.step1Text: Register with your name, email, and organization name. You become the admin of your own workspace.
landing.step2Text: Every organization gets a unique customer portal link. Share it on your website, email signature, or anywhere your customers can find it.
landing.step3Text: Invite agents, assign tickets, and reply to customers — all from a single dashboard, in English or Arabic.
landing.feat1Text: Customers submit a request with just their name and email, and track it with a reference number.
landing.feat2Text: Invite agents, assign tickets, and keep internal notes that customers never see.
landing.feat3Text: Statuses move from Open to In progress, Resolved, and Closed — so nothing gets lost.
landing.feat4Text: The entire experience works in English and Arabic, including right-to-left layout.
landing.feat5Text: Each organization's data is completely isolated from every other organization.
landing.ctaText: Create your organization and share your portal link in minutes.
